entries.Original: The acquisition tracker perform an initial scan of your characters bags when you login. entries.Original: Should the crystals be grouped together or show up in the Gather/Buy list?
entries.Translated: 水晶应分组显示还是显示在采集/购买列表中？

entries.Original: Should the currency be grouped together or show up in the Gather/Buy list?
entries.Translated: 货币应分组显示还是显示在采集/购买列表中？

entries.Original: What should the default 'Retrieve from Retainer' setting be for 'Non-output' items?
entries.Translated: 对于“非产出”物品，“从雇员取回”的默认设置应为什么？

entries.Original: What should the default 'Retrieve from Retainer' setting be for 'Output' items?
entries.Translated: 对于“产出”物品，“从雇员取回”的默认设置应为什么？

entries.Original: Which inventories should the crafting list attempt to sort the items found in 'Inventories to Retrieve From' to?
entries.Translated: 制作列表应尝试将“取回来源库存”中找到的物品排序到哪些库存？

entries.Original: Should the craft items be placed in a single table or grouped into multiple tabs.
entries.Translated: 制作物品应放在单个表格中还是分组到多个标签页中。

entries.Original: How should everything else not in it's own group be grouped?
entries.Translated: 其他不属于各自分组的内容应如何分组？

entries.Original: How should house vendor items be grouped?
entries.Translated: 房屋商人物品应如何分组？

entries.Original: When generating the materials for a craft, the 'Ingredient Sourcing' setting determines the preferred method of acquisition. The craft list will refer to this sorted list to determine the appropriate method. Please note that this assumes the item in the craft list can be obtained through this method. If not, the next item in the ingredient sourcing list will be considered.
entries.Translated: 生成制作材料时，“材料来源”设置决定首选获取方式。制作列表将参考此排序列表来确定合适的方式。请注意，这假定制作列表中的物品可通过此方式获取。若不能，则考虑材料来源列表中的下一项。

entries.Original: Is this craft list ephemeral? If checked, once all the items in the craft list are deleted, the list will delete itself. This is only checked as each craft is completed.
entries.Translated: 此制作列表是否为临时列表？若勾选，一旦制作列表中的所有物品被删除，该列表将自行删除。仅在每次制作完成时检查。

entries.Original: Should the craft list operate normally or in stocking mode. In normal mode, a quantity is entered and as you craft that number goes down. In stock mode, a quantity is entered and the number goes up based on the items within your characters inventory.
entries.Translated: 制作列表应正常运行还是处于库存模式。正常模式下，输入数量，制作时该数字递减。库存模式下，输入数量，该数字根据角色库存中的物品递增。

entries.Original: Should the list of output items be ordered in a specific way?
entries.Translated: 产出物品列表是否应按特定方式排序？

entries.Original: How should precrafts be grouped together?
entries.Translated: 预制作物品应如何分组？

entries.Original: Instead of reporting every acquisition, only print a message when an item reaches its required quantity.
entries.Translated: 不报告每次获取，仅在物品达到所需数量时输出消息。

entries.Original: Play a sound when an item is complete?
Play a sound effect when an item in this list reaches its required quantity.
entries.Translated: 当此列表中的物品达到所需数量时播放音效。

entries.Original: What to prefix each acquisition progress message with. 'Plugin Name' uses [AT], 'Craft List Name' uses the name of this craft list.
entries.Translated: 每条获取进度消息的前缀。“插件名称”使用 [AT]，“制作列表名称”使用此制作列表的名称。
是否在聊天中报告获取进度？

entries.Original: When acquiring items that are part of this craft list, print progress (e.g. "Ironwood Log 30 remaining") to chat. The craft list must be active.
entries.Translated: 当获得属于此制作清单的物品时，将进度（例如“铁木原木 剩余30”）输出到聊天框。制作清单必须处于激活状态。

entries.Original: Which sound effect to play when an item in this list reaches its required quantity (when 'Play a sound when an item is complete?' is enabled).
entries.Translated: 当此清单中的物品达到所需数量时播放哪个音效（当“物品完成时播放音效？”启用时）。

entries.Original: Report progress when you gather an item that is part of this craft list.
entries.Translated: 当你采集属于此制作清单的物品时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when you craft an item that is part of this craft list.
entries.Translated: 当你制作属于此制作清单的物品时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when you buy an item that is part of this craft list.
entries.Translated: 当你购买属于此制作清单的物品时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when an item that is part of this craft list drops from combat.
entries.Translated: 当属于此制作清单的物品从战斗中掉落时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when you buy an item that is part of this craft list from the market board.
entries.Translated: 当你从市场布告板购买属于此制作清单的物品时报告进度。

entries.Original: Report progress when an item that is part of this craft list is acquired through any other means.
entries.Translated: 当属于此制作清单的物品通过任何其他方式获得时报告进度。

entries.Original: Should the items you need to retrieve be grouped?
entries.Translated: 你需要取回的物品是否应分组？

entries.Original: Should the craft list be displayed in reverse order? i.e. Should outputs start at the bottom? (This is only applicable when the Craft Display Mode is single table)
entries.Translated: 制作列表是否按倒序显示？即输出是否从底部开始？（仅在制作显示模式为单表时适用）

entries.Original: Which inventories should the crafting list check for materials to withdraw? Items found in the selected inventories will appear in the 'Items in Retainers/Bags' list and you will need to retrieve them either before gathering or after gathering depending on your craft list's configuration.
entries.Translated: 制作清单应检查哪些物品栏以获取吸引的材料？在所选物品栏中找到的物品将出现在“雇员/背包中的物品”列表中，你需要根据制作清单的配置在采集前或采集后取回它们。

entries.Original: When crafting, what inventories should be considered the staging area? Any items in the staging area are considered in the users inventories. By default the current character's bags, crystals and currency are the staging area but if you wanted to include the saddlebag you could.
entries.Translated: 制作时，哪些物品栏应被视为模仿细胞？模仿细胞中的任何物品都被视为用户物品栏中的物品。默认情况下，当前角色的背包、水晶和货币为模仿细胞，但如果你想包含鞍囊也可以。

entries.Original: When you are in combat and an item drops and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当你在战斗中且物品掉落并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When a craft is completed and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that craft item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当完成一次制作并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该制作物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When gathering is performed and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当进行采集并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When you buy something off the market board and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当你从市场布告板购买某物并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When any other event causes you to gain an item and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当任何其他事件使你获得物品并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: When an item is purchased from a shop and it matches one of the output items in this craft list, should it reduce the quantity of that item? The craft list must be active for this to count.
entries.Translated: 当从商店购买物品并与此制作清单中的某个输出物品匹配时，是否应减少该物品的数量？制作清单必须处于激活状态才会计入。

entries.Original: Which worlds should prices be sourced from?
entries.Translated: 价格应从哪些服务器获取？

entries.Original: Should the worlds selected in 'Price Worlds' in the main settings be automatically used for pricing?
entries.Translated: 是否应自动使用主设置中“价格服务器”所选的服务器进行定价？

entries.Original: Define which inventories you want as destinations, the plugin will attempt try to take the items found in your 'Source Inventories' and sort them into your 'Destination Inventories'. You can see which inventories have been found based on the scope configuration below.
entries.Translated: 定义你希望作为目标的物品栏，插件将尝试获取在“源物品栏”中找到的物品并将它们分类到你的“目标物品栏”中。你可以根据下方的范围配置查看已找到哪些物品栏。

entries.Original: This lists all the destinations that are applicable given the destinations picked above.
entries.Translated: 此列表列出根据上方所选目标而适用的所有目标。

entries.Original: When talking with a retainer should the filter adjust itself to only show items that should be put inside the retainer from your inventory? If set to only, highlighting will only occur when at the retainer bell and when within a retainer.
entries.Translated: 与雇员交谈时，过滤器是否应自动调整以仅显示应从你的物品栏放入该雇员的物品？如果设为仅，则仅在雇员铃处及雇员内时才会高亮。

entries.Original: Filter out any items that do not appear in both the source and destination?
entries.Translated: 过滤掉任何未同时出现在源和目标中的物品？

entries.Original: When filtering items each filter set will narrow down the list of available items using AND, instead of using AND, use OR
entries.Translated: 过滤物品时，每个过滤器集将使用 AND 缩小可用物品列表，不使用 AND，而使用 OR

entries.Original: Is the item combined in the glamour chest?
entries.Translated: 该物品是否在幻化柜中合并？

entries.Original: The color to set the highlighted items to for this specific filter. If not overridden the global highlighting color will be used.
entries.Translated: 为此特定过滤器设置高亮物品的颜色。如果未覆盖，将使用全局高亮颜色。

entries.Original: Should any items that match in the destination bag be highlighted?
entries.Translated: 是否应高亮目标背包中匹配的任何物品？

entries.Original: When sorting should the filter consider HQ and NQ items to be the same when attempting to stack them? This primary use for this filter is to find items that can have their quality lowered.
entries.Translated: 分类时，过滤器在尝试堆叠时是否应将 HQ 和 NQ 物品视为相同？此过滤器的主要用途是查找可以降低品质的物品。

entries.Original: Shows a number indicating the highest patch a craft material is used in.
entries.Translated: 显示一个数字，指示制作材料所使用的最高版本。

entries.Original: Select a list of items and the filter will only display these items. You are better served using a Curated List but this filter will still work.
entries.Translated: 选择一组物品，过滤器将仅显示这些物品。使用精选列表会更好，但此过滤器仍然有效。

entries.Original: Shows the number of sales that have been made within
entries.Translated: 显示在以下天数内已完成的销售数量

entries.Original: Filter items based on the currency they can be purchased with.
entries.Translated: 根据购买物品所使用的货币筛选物品。

entries.Original: The color to set the retainers in the retainer list to for this specific filter.
entries.Translated: 为特定筛选器设置雇员列表中雇员的颜色。

entries.Original: This is a list of source inventories to sort items from based on the filter configuration
entries.Translated: 这是根据筛选配置对物品进行排序的来源背包列表

entries.Original: Define which inventories you want to be searched, these will show up in the list. You can see which inventories have been found based on the scope configuration below.
entries.Translated: 定义要搜索的库存，这些将显示在列表中。你可以根据下方的范围配置查看已找到的库存。

entries.Original: Define the scope of inventories you want to see in the historical list of inventory changes.
entries.Translated: 定义你想在库存变更历史列表中查看的库存范围。

entries.Original: Define which inventories you want to be searched, the plugin will then attempt to show you where to put them in the destinations you have selected. You can see which inventories have been found based on the scope configuration below.
entries.Translated: 定义要搜索的库存，插件将尝试向你显示在所选目标位置中放置它们的位置。你可以根据下方的范围配置查看已找到的库存。

entries.Original: This lists all the sources that are applicable given the sources picked above.
entries.Translated: 此处列出根据上方所选来源筛选出的所有适用来源。

entries.Original: The color to set the highlighted tabs(which contain filtered items) to for this specific filter. If not overridden the tab highlighting color will be used.
entries.Translated: 为特定筛选器设置高亮标签页（包含已筛选物品）的颜色。若未覆盖，将使用标签页高亮颜色。

entries.Original: The number of columns starting at 1 to freeze(always display when scrolling).
entries.Translated: 从1开始冻结的列数（滚动时始终显示）。

entries.Original: When grouping items by zone, which zones should take preference?
entries.Translated: 按区域分组物品时，应优先考虑哪些区域？

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show all the items in bags related to your character. This includes owned retainers, free company, saddle bags, etc
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示与你角色相关的所有背包中的物品。包括所属雇员、部队、陆行鸟鞍囊等

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show all of the game's items.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示游戏中的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show the items in your character's bags.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示你角色背包中的物品。

entries.Original: This will show all the items you have favourited.
entries.Translated: 这将显示你收藏的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show all the items in your free company chest for your active character.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示你当前角色部队储物柜中的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that shows you the movement of items in your inventories. History tracking must be enabled for this to function.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个列表，显示你库存中物品的移动情况。必须启用历史记录追踪才能使用此功能。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show all items stored in the houses your character owns.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示你角色拥有的房屋中存储的所有物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be preconfigured to show items across all retainer inventories.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个预配置列表，显示所有雇员库存中的物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will show all items that can be purchased from gil shops under 100 gil. It will look in both character and retainer inventories.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个列表，显示所有可在金币商店以100金币以下购买的物品。它将同时查看角色和雇员库存。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will provide a list of all the distinct stacks that appear in 2 sets of inventories. You can use this to make sure only one retainer has a specific type of item.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个列表，提供出现在两组库存中的所有不同堆叠的列表。你可以用它来确保只有一名雇员持有特定类型的物品。

entries.Original: This will add a list that will be setup to quickly put away any excess materials. It will have all the material categories automatically added. When calculating where to put items it will try to prioritise existing stacks of items.
entries.Translated: 这将添加一个列表，用于快速收回多余材料。它将自动添加所有材料类别。在计算放置位置时，它会尝试优先考虑现有的物品堆叠。

entries.Original: If a item can be acquired(mounts, minions, etc) this shows whether or not it has been acquired on the currently logged in character.
entries.Translated: 如果物品可以获取（坐骑、宠物等），则显示当前登录角色是否已获取。

entries.Original: Shows icons indicating what items can be obtained with(gathering, crafting, currency, etc)
entries.Translated: 显示图标，指示物品可以通过何种方式获得（群狼大厅、制作、货币等）

entries.Original: Display's the name of the owner of the character this item is on if applicable(retainers, free companies, etc)
entries.Translated: 显示该物品所在角色的所有者名称（如适用）（雇员、部队等）

entries.Original: This is the amount to retrieve from retainers.
entries.Translated: 这是要从雇员处取回的数量。

entries.Original: This is the amount that you could craft given the items in your inventory
entries.Translated: 这是根据你库存中的物品可以制作的数量

entries.Original: This is the amount available within your filtered inventories available to complete the craft.
entries.Translated: 这是在你已筛选的库存中可用于完成制作的数量。

entries.Original: This is the amount that needs to be sourced from MB/gathering excluding potential items to be withdrawn from retainers.
entries.Translated: 这是需要从市场板/群狼大厅获取的数量，不包括可能从雇员处取回的物品。

entries.Original: This will calculate the total amount of an item that could be crafted based on the items within your character and retainers. You can override which inventories are looked in by selecting a custom scope below.
entries.Translated: 这将根据你角色和雇员中的物品计算可制作物品的总数量。你可以通过选择下方的自定义范围来覆盖要查看的库存。

entries.Original: Please make sure you include at least one inventory that contains crystals otherwise the craft calculator will not work. If no scopes are picked, the craft calculator will look in your active characters inventories and their retainers.
entries.Translated: 请确保至少包含一个含有水晶的库存，否则制作计算器将无法工作。如果未选择任何范围，制作计算器将查看你当前角色的库存及其雇员。

entries.Original: Shows a simplified version of what you should do next in your craft
entries.Translated: 显示你在制作中下一步应该做什么的简化版本

entries.Original: The zone in which this item should be gathered from. This is only relevant to craft lists.
entries.Translated: 该物品应从哪个区域采集。这仅与制作列表相关。

entries.Original: Shows the difference between the iLvl of the item and your desynthesis skill and if desynthesis is optimal
entries.Translated: 显示物品品级与你的分解技能之间的差异，以及分解是否最优

entries.Original: Shows the minimum price of both the NQ and HQ form of the item. If no world is selected, your home world is used. This data is sourced from universalis.
entries.Translated: 显示物品NQ和HQ形式的最低价格。如果未选择服务器，则使用你的主服务器。此数据来源于universalis。

entries.Original: Shows the minimum price of the HQ form of the item. If no world is selected, your home world is used. This data is sourced from universalis.
entries.Translated: 显示物品HQ形式的最低价格。如果未选择服务器，则使用你的主服务器。此数据来源于universalis。

entries.Original: Shows the minimum price of the NQ form of the item. If no world is selected, your home world is used. This data is sourced from universalis.
entries.Translated: 显示该物品 NQ 品质的最低价格。若未选择服务器，则使用你的主服务器。数据来源于 universalis。

entries.Original: Shows the minimum price of both the NQ and HQ form of the item and multiplies it by the quantity available. If no world is selected, your home world is used. This data is sourced from universalis.
entries.Translated: 显示该物品 NQ 与 HQ 品质的最低价格，并乘以可用数量。若未选择服务器，则使用你的主服务器。数据来源于 universalis。

entries.Original: Shows the average price of both the NQ and HQ form of the item. If no world is selected, your home world is used. This data is sourced from universalis.
entries.Translated: 显示该物品 NQ 与 HQ 品质的平均价格。若未选择服务器，则使用你的主服务器。数据来源于 universalis。

entries.Original: Shows the average price of the HQ form of the item. If no world is selected, your home world is used. This data is sourced from universalis.
entries.Translated: 显示该物品 HQ 品质的平均价格。若未选择服务器，则使用你的主服务器。数据来源于 universalis。

entries.Original: Shows the average price of the NQ form of the item. If no world is selected, your home world is used. This data is sourced from universalis.
entries.Translated: 显示该物品 NQ 品质的平均价格。若未选择服务器，则使用你的主服务器。数据来源于 universalis。

entries.Original: Shows the average price of both the NQ and HQ form of the item and multiplies it by the quantity available. If no world is selected, your home world is used. This data is sourced from universalis.
entries.Translated: 显示该物品 NQ 与 HQ 品质的平均价格，并乘以可用数量。若未选择服务器，则使用你的主服务器。数据来源于 universalis。

entries.Original: The number of items available across all inventories of this item.
entries.Translated: 该物品在所有库存中的可用数量。

entries.Original: The quantity of the item. If viewing from a game items or craft filter, this will show the total number of items available in all inventories.
entries.Translated: 物品的数量。若从游戏物品或制作筛选查看，将显示所有库存中的可用物品总数。

entries.Original: This lets you set which characters you want to generate a total based off.
entries.Translated: 设置你想以哪些角色为基础生成总计。

entries.Original: If the item is selling on the market, this is the unit price it has been put up for.
entries.Translated: 若该物品正在市场上出售，这是其挂牌的单价。

entries.Original: The category of the item based off the market board search categories.
entries.Translated: 基于市场布告板搜索分类的物品类别。

entries.Original: Provides a series of small buttons that allow opening garland tools and trying on items.
entries.Translated: 提供一系列小按钮，可打开 garland tools 并试穿物品。

entries.Original: The world where the item is stored(be it in a character, retainer, free company)
entries.Translated: 物品存放的服务器（无论是在角色、雇员还是部队中）

entries.Original: Shows icons indicating what the items drop/can be used for
entries.Translated: 显示图标以指示物品的掉落来源/用途

entries.Original: The attribute to show in the column
A custom button letting you specify a custom command you wish to run with the item's name or ID
entries.Translated: 自定义按钮，可指定一个使用物品名称或 ID 运行的自定义命令

entries.Original: A custom button letting you open a webpage with the item's name or ID optionally embedded into the link.
entries.Translated: 自定义按钮，可打开一个网页，链接中可选择嵌入物品名称或 ID。

entries.Original: What mode should the equipment recommendation screen show? Class lets you pick a class and get recommendations for it. Tool lets you pick out the tools for a set of classes.
entries.Translated: 装备推荐界面应显示哪种模式？职业模式可让你选择一个职业并获取其推荐。工具模式可让你为一组职业挑选工具。

entries.Original: Should the equipment recommendation screen be compact or normal?
entries.Translated: 装备推荐界面应为紧凑还是普通？
